controls.prevents: closing, or claiming to have closed, against no frozen population
choosing the expected population after seeing which artefacts succeeded
controls.purpose: frozenAt is later than the earliest produced artefact

controls.prevents: editing a freeze after execution so the population matches what was produced
controls.purpose: the freeze bytes no longer hash to the recorded digest

controls.prevents: a closing summary that omits a MISSING member and reads as complete
controls.purpose: the closure omits the MISSING member

controls.prevents: an observed artefact entering the record without being declared or reported
controls.purpose: an observed artefact is neither declared nor recorded as UNEXPECTED

controls.prevents: an unsigned reconciliation being read as a closed, authenticated manifest
changing the reconciliation after signing and keeping the signature
controls.purpose: the signed bytes and the manifest differ

controls.prevents: declaring one identity twice so one result can satisfy two requirements
controls.purpose: one expected identity is declared twice

controls.prevents: a changed artefact being reported as produced while the summary passes
controls.purpose: a passing summary contains a DIGEST_MISMATCH member

controls.prevents: treating a build step's exit status, or a failed exit, as the artefact
controls.purpose: a non-zero exit is treated as production

controls.prevents: a PASS over a population that still has a missing required member
controls.purpose: a PASS summary over a MISSING required member

controls.prevents: closing against a different path or identity than the one frozen
controls.purpose: the observed identity differs from the frozen path

controls.prevents: reporting an unreadable artefact as absent, or an absent one as unreadable
controls.purpose: an unreadable artefact is closed as MISSING

controls.prevents: reporting an unreadable artefact as absent, or an absent one as unreadable
controls.purpose: an absent artefact is closed as UNREADABLE

controls.prevents: a summary whose counts do not add up hiding an unaccounted member
controls.purpose: the summary's counts do not reconcile with the member rows

controls.prevents: a malformed or mislabelled manifest being read as a freeze or closure
controls.purpose: a freeze plan with no members is not a manifest

controls.prevents: an envelope whose signature does not verify being accepted as signed
controls.purpose: the envelope signature does not verify

note: Every control here is control-only: a synthetic freeze, a synthetic artefact in a temporary directory and a synthetic reconciliation, all built in memory from the same code paths the real cycle uses. A control that fires proves the refusal works; it is not a defect report and not evidence that the substituted form occurs in the tree. The positive control establishes the decision procedure, not a real closure.

positive.purpose: a well-formed signed reconciliation reaches OM_VERIFIED
